Acceptance Criteria:
- 6 agents: LEXI (policy parser) / JARVIS (timesheet validator) / ORACLE (regulation watcher) / CASE (data integrity) / RIPLEY (email drafter) / TRON (ops broadcaster)
- Each has acronym + role + operational copy + 4-6 capabilities
- Per-agent color

Summary: Agents page header with operational copy + status pill
Description: As an Agent Manager I want grounded copy not marketing fluff on this page.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Title 'Agents'
- Subtitle: 1-paragraph operational description
- Right side: '6 agents · all active' pill with green dot

Description: As an Agent Manager I want a quick read on agent performance.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Auto-resolved today (318)
- Waiting on review (47)
- First-pass accuracy (94.1%)

Description: As an Agent Manager I want to see how agents collaborate so I trust the system.
Acceptance Criteria:

- Outcome line at bottom
- Each agent step is a clickable button

Description: As an Agent Manager I want roster cards ordered by pipeline position not alphabetical.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Order: LEXI / JARVIS / ORACLE / CASE / RIPLEY / TRON
- Each card: avatar / name / role / Active dot / today volume / headline metric / in:out chips / 'works in' surface

Description: As an Agent Manager I want to see recent agent actions so I trust the system is running.
Acceptance Criteria:
- 15 seeded rows reverse chrono
- Each row: agent avatar + summary + status icon + agent name + age
- Tick state updates every 60s; ages re-render without reshuffling

Description: As an Agent Manager I want to read full agent context on demand.
Acceptance Criteria:
- 440px right-slide on agent click
- Shows: acronym / operational copy / today + metric tiles / capabilities / hand-off chips / 'surfaces in' footer

Description: As an Agent Manager I want the agent design principles visible so I can articulate them to clients.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Pink card with 3 principles

Acceptance Criteria:
- Fixed bottom-4 right-4, 440px wide
- Pink-50 header with kind label + close
- Form fields: To / CC / Subject / Body
- Source link footer when sourceUrl provided
- Send simulates 500ms then ✓ Sent then auto-close

Description: As a developer I want all email flows centralised in one component with named builders.
Acceptance Criteria:
- compliance / client-compliance / timesheet-flag / timesheet-reject / timesheet-approve / timesheet-team / document-request / onboarding-issue / payroll-issue
- Each returns NotifyContext with kind / to / cc / subject / body
- Per-kind label + To/CC defaults

Description: As a Compliance Lead I want subject lines that scan in inboxes.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Timesheet emails: '<prefix> — <code>: <main issue>[ (N issues)] · <period>'

- Client compliance: '<client> · action required: <title>'
- Onboarding: 'Onboarding blocker — <candidate> · <type>'
- Document request: 'Document update required — <docType>'
- Payroll: 'Payroll review — <client> · <cycle>'

Description: As an Agent Manager I want emails to feel ops-written.
Acceptance Criteria:
- No 'JARVIS confidence' line
- No 'Drafted by RIPLEY' inline
- No 'AI agent says' phrasing

Summary: Real LLM call replaces template builders
Description: As an Agent Manager I want truly contextual emails not templated text.
Acceptance Criteria:
- LLM call from each builder
- Structured-output JSON schema

- Per-client tone & signature variation

Summary: Real send via Postmark / SES / Gmail API

- Backend route: POST /api/notify/send
